changelog: [When to Segment]: Added two permissive rules so boundaries before a not-yet-arrived reporting/opinion verb, governing verb, postposed subject, or disambiguating continuation of an idiomatic phrase are still marked as candidates instead of being withheld — increases coverage per critic focus.

[Priority Rules]: Added a new lowest tier (8) that explicitly demotes boundaries preceding a pending reporting/opinion verb, governing verb, postposed subject, or idiomatic-phrase disambiguation, addressing the placement cases by ranking them last rather than deleting them as candidates.
